notes: FULL STATION GRAPH PACK: unlike the Zurich pack in this same wave (roster-only, no web-fetch tool), this published-network.json contains all five TPG tram lines' full ordered stops[] arrays, hand-transcribed by the oracle report itself and reshaped (not re-verified against a live source) by this Luke pass.

City id geneva is unused in existing packs. Display Geneva. Agency TPG (Transports publics genevois), within the unireso fare community. Do not invent city=ge, city=gva, city=tpg, or city=lemanis. Do not merge into another Swiss city (Zurich, Lausanne). Do not merge with Leman Express or bus operators.
City stays planned until Jim wires an adapter and Tim resolves the licence-confidence hazard. assertCityLive("geneva") must fail (city not in lib/providers/registry.js CITIES).
Modes v1: TPG TRAM ONLY (lines 12, 14, 15, 17, 18). No Leman Express (CFF/SNCF commuter rail), no buses (TPG or external), no trolleybuses, no boats. No metro exists in Geneva.

Passenger tram line roster (2026, per oracle report): 12, 14, 15, 17, 18. Future line 6 / Ferney-Voltaire extension (construction Sep 2025-end 2028, exact line assignment unclear) is explicitly OUT of the v1 passenger roster.

Hub lock: CORNAVIN (tram), i.e. Genève, gare Cornavin. Chosen per explicit task instruction. WARNING (see hazard-pack.md H4): the oracle report gives three different, mutually inconsistent claims about which lines call Cornavin (hub-lock prose says 12/14/15; inline stop annotations say 14/15/17/18; this pack's own recount directly from the five transcribed stations[] arrays says 14/15/18). This file uses the recount (14, 15, 18) in each line's branches[] entry, but that figure is NOT independently re-verified against the official TPG map either - confirm before building a line-map generator on top of it.

doNotGroup Leman Express / SBB Genf-Cornavin vs TPG tram gare Cornavin (hub, shared address, separate platforms/operator). Same shape at Genève-Eaux-Vives, gare (vs Leman Express Eaux-Vives/CEVA), Lancy-Pont-Rouge, gare and Lancy-Pont-Rouge, gare/Etoile (vs Leman Express Lancy-Pont-Rouge - two distinct tram stops, do not collapse into each other either), and Lancy-Bachet, gare (vs Leman Express Lancy-Bachet). See each station object's doNotGroup field and hazard-pack.md H1.

Moillesulaz asymmetry hazard: Thonex, Moillesulaz is a TERMINUS on line 12 (Switzerland-France boundary, does not cross into France) but a THROUGH-STATION on line 17 (continues into France: Gaillard, Ambilly, Annemasse). Do not model it as a symmetric hub - see direction-model-memo.md.

Cross-border hazard: line 17's final four stops (Gaillard x2, Ambilly, Annemasse) are in France. GTFS-RT data quality for this segment is unconfirmed per the oracle report's skip-risk section - flagged, not resolved. See each stop's country/note fields and line 17's crossBorder block below.

ARITHMETIC HAZARD, found in this pass: the oracle report's own Summary section states unique stops = 94, but a direct recount from the five transcribed stations[] arrays in this same file (identical station-name dedup) yields 86 unique stations (135 total stop-line appearances, 49 repeats at interchange stations). stats.stationsTranscribed below reports 86, computed directly from this file's own data, NOT the report's 94 summary figure. Flagged for Tim/Nico, not silently reconciled - see hazard-pack.md H2.

Timezone Europe/Zurich HAS DST (UTC+1 standard / UTC+2 summer, last Sunday March-last Sunday October). Do not copy Perth/Brisbane no-DST assumptions. Line 17's French terminus (Annemasse) observes the same EU DST schedule; not independently verified against a French-authority source.

LICENCE HAZARD, flagged for Tim, not resolved here: opentransportdata.swiss Terms of Use has no named licence (not CC BY, not CC0, not ODbL) - platform 'Open Data' language only, attribution required, third-party redistribution to end users of a commercial app not explicitly addressed. Oracle report confidence rating: unclear. Same underlying feed as the Zurich and Lausanne packs. See hazard-pack.md.

AUTH HAZARD, flagged for Tim, not resolved here: GTFS-RT (https://api.opentransportdata.swiss/la/gtfs-rt) requires a Bearer API key (401 without one), registered via https://api-manager.opentransportdata.swiss/, personal/non-transferable per SBB terms, rate-limited to 2 queries per minute (sliding window) - shared feed with Zurich and Lausanne, now a third city competing for the same rate-limited key pool if all three are wired. No key is present in this pack; no live calls were made. See hazard-pack.md.

gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown are the printed passenger line numbers per the oracle report (not extracted from a live GTFS pull in this pass). No stopIds in this file - product child stopIds stay out of D1 per task instruction.

Feed / live (Jim D2, not a D1 generator, and not buildable until the licence-confidence hazard above is resolved by Tim): opentransportdata.swiss GTFS-RT, filtered to agency=TPG and route_type=0 (tram) to exclude Leman Express, S-Bahn, and bus bleed from the shared national protobuf stream. Static GTFS from the same Switzerland-national feed, same filter requirement. D1 stays planned.

printedInnerCityNames.lockNote: Hub lock chosen per explicit task instruction. Genève, gare Cornavin is the downtown central arrival hub, primary tram + Leman Express + SBB interchange point. This pack's direct recount from the five transcribed stations[] arrays finds lines 14, 15, 18 calling here (not 12 or 17) - see hazard-pack.md H4 for the three-way discrepancy with the oracle report's own prose/annotations. Not a direction token.

coverageGaps: Léman Express (CFF/SNCF commuter rail) - out of v1 mode scope entirely (out-product on the board-eligibility table, not a boarding-contract failure). No station rows for Léman Express-only stops (e.g. Genève-Aéroport, Champel, Sécheron) in this file.
TPG buses and external bus operators - out of v1 mode scope.
Trolleybuses (TPG) - out of v1 mode scope.
Boat/ferry services (Lake Geneva, Rhône) - out of v1 mode scope.
Future line 6 / Ferney-Voltaire tram extension (construction Sep 2025-end 2028) - out of the v1 passenger roster, exact line assignment unclear per oracle report. No station rows invented.
Cornavin's true line set is not independently re-verified against the official TPG map - see the three-way discrepancy in hazard-pack.md H4.
Unique-stop-count arithmetic discrepancy between this file's computed 86 and the oracle report's stated 94 - not resolved, see hazard-pack.md H2.
GTFS-RT data quality for line 17's four French stops (Gaillard x2, Ambilly, Annemasse) is unconfirmed - see hazard-pack.md cross-border section.
Short turns not checked on any of the five lines - do not assume none exist.
